purpose: Test the frozen sparse/tonal descriptor's dependence on sample rate, analysis bandwidth and recorded context before relying on it for the authorized clean capture. Preserve all historical candidate outcomes and thresholds.

rate_experiment.waveform: x(t)=8192*sum_k cos(2*pi*k*(375/8)*t+phase_k). Coherent and tone phases are zero. Hash phases use the first 64 bits of SHA256(seed+'/'+decimal k), divided by 2^64 and multiplied by 2*pi; the same harmonic has the same phase in both hash families.
rate_experiment.sampling: Evaluate one period at the 192000-Hz master grid with math.fsum in ascending harmonic order; Python round to integer once. Stride the common quantized grid by 4, 2 or 1 and repeat six periods. This directly samples the declared periodic function; it does not invoke a media resampler or change its physical frequencies.
rate_experiment.identity_check: Every lower-rate kernel must equal the corresponding stride of the higher-rate kernel exactly at all shared sample instants. Assert signed 24-bit range. Record counts and boolean equality only, no waveform or PCM hash.
rate_experiment.execution: Run unchanged classify on all 12 kernels. Report frozen outputs and physical FFT window duration/bin spacing. The short kernels are not eligible source members or listening stimuli.
rate_experiment.padded_execution: Place the unchanged 0.128-second kernel into exact zeros at seven seconds; run classify. This tests permitted rate/duration/quiet geometry only. A synthesized periodic multisine is not one natural transient or an eligible clean capture.
rate_experiment.comparison: Report changes in each spectral flag and contrast classification relative to 48000 Hz. Do not require a preferred result, tune a seed, substitute a family, or select a new descriptor.

context_experiment.waveform: A constant nonzero synthetic interval, zero elsewhere. This is an occupancy-only construction, not a natural acoustic event or spectral/non-tonal fixture.
context_experiment.execution: Run unchanged time_occupancy on all eight cases. Independently compute exact per-block overlap lengths and Fraction powers from integer interval endpoints, using the same declared 1/1000 threshold.
context_experiment.comparison: Separately compare a 50-ms translation at fixed 15-second duration and adding 15 seconds of trailing zeros at fixed 5.950-second onset. Shared event samples are unchanged; report activity and sparse-state differences.
context_experiment.interpretation: Whole-recording occupancy is intentionally context-relative. A changed label establishes context dependence, not a programming bug or proof of incorrect natural-source classification.

next_requirement: Use the observed invariance or non-invariance to decide whether a separately justified physical-band/context definition is needed. Any changed descriptor requires a new score-blind plan and fresh validation; do not reinterpret consumed source outcomes or modify this capture specification retrospectively.
